zh: 所有行完全相同，所以只要构造出一行，再重复输出 n 次。
一行由 n 个星号组成，相邻星号之间恰好一个空格，行首行尾都没有多余空格。
把 n 个 * 用单个空格连接得到一行，然后输出 n 次，每行以换行结束。本题按字节精确比较，注意不要多出空格或空行。
en: All rows are identical, so build one row and print it n times.
A row consists of n asterisks with exactly one space between neighbors and no extra space at either end.
Join n copies of * with single spaces to form the row, then print it n times, each followed by a newline. The output is compared exactly, so avoid stray spaces or blank lines.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Build one line of n asterisks joined by single spaces, then output that line n times.

## Proof of correctness

Each line contains n asterisks with exactly one space between adjacent ones, and it is repeated n times, matching the output definition character by character.

## Complexity

Both time and output space are O(n^2).
